He founded Merchant Hub, a payment-processing business serving both American and European merchants, and later launched the cryptocurrency platform Comet Cash. His other business interests have included commercial property development and the Rock 13 tequila brand.

long_biography.plain_text:
Tommy Kato took up riding after watching the Miami Beach Polo World Cup and deciding he wanted to compete. He trained with Luis Escobar at Santa Clara Polo Club in Wellington, then progressed to international fixtures. By 2014, he was making his third consecutive appearance in the beach tournament and had also played at London's O2 Arena.

Wine became another practical interest. Through Napa Valley Reserve, Kato worked with the Harlan Estate team on a cabernet sauvignon blend intended to carry his name. He sought a full-bodied wine with delicacy, paying attention to the harvest's weather and rainfall rather than treating age alone as a guide to quality.

Tommy Kato took up riding after watching the Miami Beach Polo World Cup and deciding he wanted to compete. He trained with Luis Escobar at Santa Clara Polo Club in Wellington, then progressed to international fixtures. By 2014, he was making his third consecutive appearance in the beach tournament and had also played at London's O2 Arena.

Wine became another practical interest. Through Napa Valley Reserve, Kato worked with the Harlan Estate team on a cabernet sauvignon blend intended to carry his name. He sought a full-bodied wine with delicacy, paying attention to the harvest's weather and rainfall rather than treating age alone as a guide to quality.
